Student who enrolls in College of International Studies cannot transfer to the other colleges in Gachon University except for the students who have over
** International liberal studies
Student who enrolls in this major is required to take the Korean intensive subjects for the first year(two semesters) in order to learn how to get used
to Korean culture, life and improve the ability to learn the specific liberal arts and majors.
After one year, students who want to choose the specific major, they need to achieve the Korean Proficiency Test(TOPIK) over level 3 or take a pass

heading: Source page subsection
content:
result of major-decision test held by Gachon University. Otherwise, students would belong to the International(Koreanology) major.
In addition, when students choose the specific major on the 2nd year, preliminary education, nursing, dental hygienic, emergency medical technology,
radiology, physical therapy, pharmacy, medical science, art & physical education, smart factory, smart security, smart city, biologics, finance & big data is
not applicable based on the principal of Gachon University. Also, if students want to choose Business administration and Tourism management in
College of Business, Media communication and Psychology in College of Social Science, and Computer engineering in College of AI·Computing, students
are required to achieve the Korean Proficiency Test(TOPIK) over level 4 only.

heading: Source page subsection
content:
1) Online application and Submission of required documents
A. Online application is through www.jinhakapply.com
B. It does not allow to change the details after the payment of an admission fee. After the application period is over, it is not
acceptable for the student to cancel his/her application and the admission fee is not refundable.
C. When filling in the application form, the applicant's contact information and address must be accurately stated, and the
applicant himself/herself is responsible for the disadvantages caused by unclear information entry and omission.
D. All the documents submitted cannot be returned regardless of whether or not the applicant is accepted.
2) Acceptance & Cancellation of Admission
A. The applicant can choose the first and second departments. All the evaluation will be covered the first and second
departments, if the applicant is unsatisfied by the evaluation, he/she will not be accepted.

heading: Source page subsection
content:
B. Successful applicants(admissions) must be informed of the NOTE notified when announcing successful applicants, and the
applicant himself/herself is responsible for the disadvantaged caused by not paying attention to the NOTE.
C. Those who do not have less than TOPIK Level 4 or do not have TOPIK result have to follow the below condition
① Freshman : Korean language courses 34 credits for the first year(17 credits per semester) * English track 15 credits for the first semester
② Transfer : Korean language course 12 credits for the first semester * English track is not applicable
③ Freshman & Transfer in common * English track is not applicable
- Student must achieve TOPIK Level 4 or higher before graduation in order to graduate
- If student does not achieve TOPIK Level 4 or higher before the graduation, he/she has to take the additional program

heading: Source page subsection
content:
conducted by Gachon University before graduation in order to graduate. Student takes a responsibility for the program fee.
D. In the case of transfer students, the graduation period may be extended if they need to complete additional courses required
for graduation according to the credit recognition review.
E. If the submitted documents are different from the facts, or if it is found that acceptance or admission has been made through

heading: Source page subsection
content:
other illegal methods, acceptance and admission will be canceled even after admission, and tuition fee is not refundable.
F. Students cannot double-enroll in two or more colleges, universities, industrial colleges, or colleges of education with the
same semester of admission. Acceptance(admission) will be canceled in case of violation of double registration prohibition, and
tuition fee is not refundable.
G. Those who are expected to graduate or complete from the previous school should submit the certificate of graduation or completion to
Office of International Affairs before the beginning of a semester. Otherwise, the acceptance and admission will be cancelled.
H. Even if acceptance(admission) is granted, if it is confirmed that the applicant does not meet the qualifications according to the
review of financial documents and academic background documents, the admission will be cancelled.

heading: Source page subsection

ÿ  Refund  requests  are  possible  on  public  holidays,  but  deposit  processing  is  not  available.

A.  You  may  apply  to  up  to  5  universities  in  the  1st  Early  Admission  round,  up  to  5  in  the  2nd  Early  Admission  round,  and  up  to  3  in  the  Regular  Admission  round.

ÿ  Please  be  careful  to  frequently  check  the  admission  status  with  the  universities  you  applied  to  to  avoid  any  issues.

Principles  for  evaluating  successful  candidates
Selection  is  based  on  the  total  score  (1,000  points)  calculated  by  summing  the  scores  obtained  for  each  recruitment  unit  (selection  type),  and  the  final  comprehensive  score  is  calculated  up  to  the  fifth  decimal  place.

The  Smart  Automotive  &  Electrical  Machinery  Department  fosters  field-oriented  professional  talent  in  the  fields  of  smart  automobiles,  AI-integrated  machinery,  secondary  battery  systems,  shipbuilding,
electric  energy,  industrial  machinery,  and  fire  safety  management.  Reflecting  the  demands  of  the  automotive,  shipbuilding,  secondary  battery,  electric  energy,  and  machinery  industries  in  the  Gunsan
and  Saemangeum  regions,  the  department  offers  training  in  CAD/CAM,  electric  vehicle  diagnostics,  battery  manufacturing,  quality,  and  safety,  shipbuilding  welding,  automation  equipment,  and  AI-based

technical  qualifications,  and  career  counseling.
•  Smart  Automotive  Machinery  Major  •  AI  Convergence  Machinery  Major  •  Secondary  Battery  Systems  Major  •  Shipbuilding  Major  •  Electrical  Energy  Major  •  Industrial  Machinery  Major
The  automotive  and  machinery,  renewable  energy,  secondary  battery  and  chemical  engineering,  and  shipbuilding  industries  are  pivotal  national  industries.  In  particular,  to  promptly  respond  to  trends  in  local  industries—such  as

Department  of  Physical  Therapy  (3-year  program)
•  The  Department  of  Physical  Therapy  at  Kunjang  University  [produces]  highly  skilled  physical  therapy  professionals  who  assist  in  the  recovery  of  various  bodily  functions,  including  the  musculoskeletal,  nervous,  and  cardiopulmonary  systems.
•  This  department  covers  future  healthcare  trends  such  as  AI  rehabilitation,  digital  healthcare,  wearable  assessment,  and  tele-rehabilitation
We  operate  a  convergence  curriculum  that  reflects  this,  and  provide  simulation  practice  reflecting  actual  clinical  settings  and  community-based  clinical  practice  programs
Through  this,  we  cultivate  practical  skills  that  enable  immediate  clinical  deployment  right  after  graduation.

heading: Source page subsection
content:
•  Through  the  3-year  Associate's  degree  program  and  the  1-year  Bachelor's  degree  advanced  major  program,  it  is  possible  to  both  link  degree  attainment  and  deepen  clinical  expertise,  and  to  pursue  graduate  studies
We  also  actively  support  growth  as  researchers,  educators,  and  professional  physical  therapists.
•  Self-directed  learning  competency  –  Cultivating  lifelong  learning  abilities  to  actively  respond  to  the  changing  medical  environment  and  continuously  develop  professional  expertise
•  Ethical  Communication  Competency  –  Cultivating  ethical  awareness  and  multidisciplinary  collaboration  skills  to  practice  holistic  treatment  based  on  respect  for  life  and  human  rights

heading: Important Notes for Application
content:
- The application will be completed only after all required information has been entered and the application fee has been paid by the application deadline.
- Applicants must carefully check their eligibility and the department to which they are applying before submitting the application. The application fee is non-refundable after the application deadline.
- Thd   n  p     od .
- In the case of multiple applications within the same application round, applications other than the initial application will be canceled.
- Applicants must enter all information accurately, including email address and phone number.
- An application number will be issued after submission and will be used for information regarding the interview schedule, admission results.
- Even if you have completed the online application, if you do not submit the required documents until submission period, you will not be able to take the interview and will be disqualified.
- Applicants should submit completed paperwork during application period, if applicants fail to submit the required documents which affects admission status, he/she will be disqualified without further notice.
- Only language proficiency test scores issued within the past two (2) years will be accepted. (TOPIK, TOEFL, IELTS, TEPS, and New TEPS; JLPT excluded)
- If applicants submit the scanned copies of documents, they must submit original documents later. If these two documents are not the same, your admission cannot be guaranteed.
- All the submitted documents except the original diploma, graduation certificate will not be returned.
- Applicants who submitted a certificate of expected graduation at the time of application must submit the original degree certificate or graduation certificate to the Office of International Affairs by February 19, 2027. Failure to do so will result in cancellation of admission.

content:

content:

- Multi-nationals with Korean citizenship are not eligible.
- Eligible Nationality Status must be established before the application due date.

heading: 1. Applications
content:
- Applicants may apply to both Track I and Track II simultaneously.
- A. Application Period
- Spring Semester: Oct. 12, 2026 (Mon), 09:00 – Oct. 30, 2026 (Fri), 18:00
- Fall Semester: Apr. 12, 2027 (Mon), 09:00 – Apr. 30, 2027 (Fri), 18:00
- B. Application Website: Uway Apply (Link available on the KNU OIA website: www.uwayapply.com)
- C. Application Number: Automatically generated upon successful completion of the online application
- D. Application Procedure:
- During the application period, upload the required documents listed in "6. Required Documents" (Page 11).
- Upload one PDF file for each document item (① – ④).
- Do NOT upload all required documents as a single PDF file

heading: Online Application Process
content:
- Upload the required documents (1) in the order listed under "6. Required Documents" and (2) as one PDF file per document item.
- ▶Applications applying to both Track I and Track Il must upload a separate set of application documents for each application number.
- ▶An application is considered complete only after the application fee has been paid. Once payment has been made, no changes may be made to the application.
- ▶The application fee will be fully refunded if the application is withdrawn before 18:00 on Oct. 30, 2026 (Spring Semester) or before 18:00 on Apr. 30, 2027 (Fall Semester). No refund will be provided after the application deadline.
- ▶Applicants should keep their five-digit application number for future reference.
- ▶Heavy website traffic is expected on the application deadline. Applicants are strongly advised to complete their application well in advance.
- ▶For inquiries regarding the online application system: Uway Apply (+82-1588-8988)

heading: 2Apostille
content: Since July 14, 2007, the Republic of Korea has been part of the 1961 Hague Convention abolishing the Requirement of Legalization for Foreign Public Documents. The Convention provides for the use of simplified certification of public documents (including notarized documents) among countries that have joined the convention. The "Apostille" designation ensures that public documents issued in one signatory country will be recognized as valid in another signatory country.

heading: 2Apostille
content:
- NoTE: Newly admitted students from countries that are signatories to the convention must meet the following requirements:
- ① Official certificates (transcripts, diplomas, etc.) from public schools or institutions should be submitted together with an "Apostille"attachment.
- ②Official certificates (transcripts, diplomas, etc.) from private schools or institutions, however, should be officially notarized by a notary, agency, or any other authority competent under the law of the country of origin of the certificates; then, the certificates should be submitted together with an "Apostille" attachment.
